visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Transparent liquid bottles labeled 'Transparent Soy Sauce' in Japanese are displayed on a shelf in a brightly lit retail store. A pink and white price tag sits below them, showing numbers and logos. (2) Three young men with black hair are sitting on a grey couch in a living room behind a light wood table. A plate of pale dumplings and a small sauce dish are on the table. (3) A hand pours clear liquid from the bottle onto the dumplings. A circular video insert in the corner shows the central man reacting with an exaggeratedly surprised facial expression and open mouth. (4) The three men use chopsticks to eat the dumplings, looking at the food and each other while talking animatedly. Their hands move frequently as they gesture during the conversation in the bright indoor setting. (5) A close-up shot shows the bottle of transparent soy sauce standing next to two bowls of braised pork rice. The meat looks unusually light in color, resembling boiled meat rather than typical dark braised pork. (6) A hand pours the clear liquid into a small white ceramic dish to show its water-like transparency. The central man's reaction continues in a small circular inset, showing his face and gestures. (7) A wooden spoon stirs pieces of pork belly and fat in a light-colored simmering liquid inside a pot. The scene transitions to the men eating the braised pork rice from white bowls. (8) One man closes his eyes and chews thoughtfully, tasting the pale braised pork rice. The others watch him closely with curious expressions. Pink heart graphics and yellow emphasis text overlays appear around them. (9) The transparent liquid is poured directly onto a white cloth surface. The fabric becomes wet and damp but shows no dark stain or color change, demonstrating the product's unique physical property. (10) The three men laugh and joke together, with one man pointing towards the camera. They continue eating and discussing the product's impact on their sensory perception in the casual living room environment.
